title: Hamilton
description: A bold and innovative musical blending hip-hop, rap, and jazz to tell the story of Alexander Hamilton and the United States from 1780 to 1800. 48 songs across two acts cover the nation's founding — slavery, the War of Independence, the Constitution — packed with intrigue, betrayals, scandals, and love affairs.

title: Les Misérables
description: Based on Victor Hugo's novel: Jean Valjean, a former convict just released from prison, struggles for two decades to stay out of trouble under a new identity while pursued by Inspector Javert. Set in war-devastated 19th-century France.

title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
description: Brad and Janet get caught in the rain on their way to visit a friend and seek refuge in a mysterious castle full of eccentric and strange characters.

title: Moulin Rouge!
description: Belle Époque Paris: Christian, a penniless young poet, moves to Montmartre and is hired to write a spectacular show for the Moulin Rouge — where he falls in love with Satine, the cabaret's star courtesan.

title: The Greatest Showman
description: A celebration of the birth of show business, inspired by the ambition and imagination of P.T. Barnum — a visionary who rose from nothing to create a global phenomenon.

title: West Side Story
description: In New York's West Side, two rival gangs clash: the Sharks, led by Bernardo, and the Jets, led by Riff. Former Jet Tony falls in love with Maria, Bernardo's sister.

title: Into the Woods
description: Several well-known fairy tales intertwine — Cinderella, Little Red Riding Hood, Jack and the Beanstalk, Rapunzel — alongside a baker and his wife who hope to start a family but are cursed by a witch.

title: Newsies
description: July 1899: young newspaper sellers in New York go on strike, demanding better working conditions from their employer, Joseph Pulitzer.

title: Annie
description: Inspired by the comic strip Little Orphan Annie: a ten-year-old orphan fights the cruelty of her caretakers until an encounter with billionaire Oliver Warbucks changes her fate.

title: Hello, Dolly!
description: Professional matchmaker Dolly Levi falls in love with a wealthy merchant and orchestrates a complex web of relationships to achieve her goal.

title: Matilda the Musical
description: The Tony and Olivier Award-winning musical about an extraordinary young girl with an overactive imagination who decides to change her destiny — with astonishing results.

title: Aladdin
description: How Aladdin, through the treachery of the Grand Vizier, acquires the magic lamp containing the famous genie — leading him on the most incredible adventure.

title: Twisted: The Untold Story of a Royal Vizier
description: A retelling of Aladdin from Jafar's perspective, similar in approach to Wicked. By StarKid Productions.

title: Anastasia
description: Inspired by the 1997 animated film: Anya, an amnesiac orphan, hopes to find her family — unknowingly aided by two con artists exploiting her resemblance to the lost princess Anastasia Romanov.

title: The Prom
description: A teenage girl in Indiana wants to take her girlfriend to prom but faces staunch opposition — until a group of eccentric Broadway actors mobilizes to support her and fight the injustice.

title: tick, tick... BOOM!
description: As his 30th birthday approaches, a promising young composer struggles with love, friendship, and the desire to create something extraordinary before time runs out. Jonathan Larson's autobiographical musical, filmed for Netflix.

title: Diana: The Musical
description: Based on the life of Diana Spencer. Its Broadway premiere was delayed by the pandemic, so it premiered on Netflix instead, filmed without a live audience.

title: Shrek: The Musical
description: Lord Farquaad wants to marry Princess Fiona, but she's imprisoned by a fearsome dragon. He needs a brave knight — and the ogre Shrek volunteers.

title: Mamma Mia!
description: A young bride-to-be seeks to discover the identity of her father — a secret her mother refuses to reveal. Set to the music of ABBA.

title: Everybody's Talking About Jamie
description: Defying all obstacles, 16-year-old Jamie has the courage to pursue his unique dream of becoming a drag queen, in an uplifting true story that became a hit West End musical.
notes: The movie is in the visual media category too!

title: Dear Evan Hansen
description: Evan Hansen, a 17-year-old with social anxiety, writes letters to himself on his therapist's advice. When classmate Connor dies by suicide, Evan gets caught in a web of lies after falsely claiming to have been Connor's best friend.

title: Chicago
description: 1920s Chicago: Roxie Hart, who has killed her lover, meets Velma Kelly, a cabaret star who murdered her husband and sister. Roxie dreams of achieving Velma's fame.

title: Wicked
description: The story of two opposites: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, and Glinda, the Good Witch — a friendship tested by personality clashes, romantic rivalry, and the corrupt government of the Wizard of Oz.

title: Miss Saigon
description: Kim, a young girl working at Dreamland, a seedy bar frequented by American soldiers, meets and falls passionately in love with Chris, a U.S. GI — before war separates them.
